gaps: The Bagaroua registration constraint concerns access to the social registry; it must not be merged with the earlier drought cash programme's beneficiary count.
All new findings describe 2025 conditions and reported outputs; no causal effectiveness evaluation or verified October 2026 caseload is supplied.

executive_assessment.text: Local additions identify nutrition concerns in Diffa/Maradi/Zinder and preparedness outputs in Diffa, rather than a new nationwide local-risk ranking.
Insecurity constrained northern Bagaroua social-registry access, while drought-related transfer outputs are separately documented; registration and actual payments are not interchangeable.
